description: This line plot illustrates the similarity scores across different model layers for four language pair combinations: en&en (red), en&es (blue), en&el (green), and en&bn (magenta), as evaluated in the context of layer-wise mixture-of-experts for multilingual LLMs. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 22 with integer tick marks at every 2 units, representing discrete transformer layers. The y-axis, labeled “Similarity,” ranges from 0.00 to 0.45 in increments of 0.05, indicating the degree of similarity (likely between representations or expert activations). The red line (en&en) starts near 0.07, peaks around layer 6 at ~0.26, dips to ~0.15 by layer 8, fluctuates mildly until layer 20 (~0.08), then surges sharply to ~0.44 at layer 23. The blue line (en&es) follows a similar trajectory but peaks lower at ~0.24 at layer 6, then declines to ~0.05 by layer 20 before rising to ~0.27 at layer 23. The green line (en&el) begins near 0.04, peaks at ~0.15 at layer 6, drops to ~0.05 by layer 20, and climbs to ~0.30 at layer 23. The magenta line (en&bn) starts lowest at ~0.03, peaks at ~0.14 at layer 6, falls to ~0.05 by layer 20, and rises to ~0.30 at layer 23. All lines show a pronounced increase in similarity in the final layers, particularly after layer 20, suggesting a convergence or specialization of representations in deeper layers for multilingual expansion.
